% !TeX program = lualatex
% The geometry deck: slides that only tests/test_hook_geometry.py measures (the text margins, a frame title with a
% subtitle, side footnotes in a standard frame). They are not in the calibration deck because they do what
% tools/check_layout.py would flag (a strip beside the text margin) and the calibration deck is held to a count
% of exempted findings. Same template and chrome as the calibration deck.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}

\makeatletter
\def\input@path{{../}}
\makeatother
\graphicspath{{../}}

\input{SlideMage_template_stress-test}

\newcommand{\FooterText}{Geometry deck}

\ifdefined\deckversionoverride
	\deckversion[\deckversionoverride]
\else
	\deckversion[instructor]
\fi
\decklanguage[en]

\begin{document}

	\slide{ZG1-EN-Text-Margins}
	\slide{ZG2-EN-Side-Footnotes}
	\slide{ZG3-EN-Side-Footnotes-Revealed}
	\slide{ZG4-EN-Image-Source-Revealed}

\end{document}
